title: Venturo Privacy Policy
summary: Venturo respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.
meta: Business: Viatori Ventures (Pty) Ltd trading as Venturo

blocks.text: Venturo respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.
This Privacy Policy explains how Viatori Ventures (Pty) Ltd trading as Venturo collects, uses, stores, shares & protects personal information when you use:
This Policy should be read together with the Venturo Terms & Conditions and Refund & Cancellation Policy.
Venturo processes personal information in accordance with applicable South African law, including the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 ("POPIA").
2. Who Is Responsible for Your Information?
For purposes of POPIA, the responsible party is:
Viatori Ventures (Pty) Ltd trading as Venturo
Venturo determines why & how personal information is processed for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.
Personal information is information relating to an identifiable living person and, where applicable under South African law, an identifiable existing juristic person.
It may include information such as:
other information that can reasonably be linked to a person.
The information Venturo collects depends on how you use the Platform.
When you create or manage a Venturo account, we may collect:
Passwords are handled through Venturo's authentication systems and should not be visible to Venturo personnel in plain text.
Venturo is designed to personalise activity discovery.
We may therefore collect information that you provide about your interests & preferences, including:
other choices you make within the Platform.
This information helps Venturo recommend activities, events & communities that may be relevant to you.
Venturo may use location information to provide features such as:
Where device location permission is required, Venturo will request permission through the applicable device or operating-system process.
You can control device location permission through your device settings.
If you choose not to provide precise device location, you may still be able to search or select locations manually where this functionality is available.
Venturo will only use location information for purposes reasonably connected to the functionality described to you.
If you subscribe to Venturo Membership, we may process information such as:
Venturo may receive confirmation from third-party subscription or payment providers that a payment or subscription is valid.
Where you make a payment to Venturo, we may process:
information required for accounting, fraud prevention or customer support.
Payments may be processed by third-party payment providers such as PayFast or, for applicable in-app subscriptions, through the relevant app marketplace.
Venturo does not intend to store full payment-card numbers, card security codes or similar raw payment credentials where these are processed securely by the applicable payment provider.
The payment provider may separately process personal information under its own privacy policy and terms.
Where Venturo Membership is purchased through an app marketplace such as Apple, the marketplace processes the payment under its own systems.
Venturo may receive information required to determine whether the Venturo account has an active subscription.
Subscription-management technology may also be used to verify subscription status & associate the entitlement with the correct Venturo account.
Venturo does not receive the User's full Apple payment credentials.
If you register for or attend a Venturo-operated event, we may collect information reasonably necessary to administer the event, such as:
For certain activities, a User may voluntarily provide information relevant to safe participation.

Where this information qualifies as special personal information, Venturo will process it only where there is an appropriate lawful basis and where it is reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was provided.
Venturo may allow Users to upload or publish content such as:
Some User-Generated Content may be visible to other Users or the public.
Before publishing content, Users should avoid including personal information that they do not want others to see.
Users should also avoid publishing another person's personal information without an appropriate reason or permission.
Venturo may process User-Generated Content for moderation, platform operation, safety, support & enforcement of the Venturo Terms & Conditions.
If you join or participate in a Venturo community, we may process information including:
Depending on the community design, certain information about your participation may be visible to other community members.
Where a person represents an activity business, venue, event organiser or other business using Venturo, we may collect:
transaction information relating to services purchased from Venturo.
Some business information may already be publicly available.
Venturo may use publicly available business information for legitimate directory, verification & business-contact purposes, subject to applicable law.
10. Information You Give Us Through Support
When you contact Venturo, we may process:
information reasonably required to investigate the issue.
Support records may be retained where necessary for customer service, dispute resolution, fraud prevention, security or legal purposes.
When you use the Venturo Platform, certain technical information may be generated automatically.
approximate technical location derived from network information where applicable.
We use this information to operate, secure, troubleshoot & improve the Platform.
The Venturo website may use cookies or similar technologies.
Where required, Venturo may provide Users with controls relating to optional cookies.
Essential cookies required for security, authentication or core website operation may operate without optional marketing-cookie consent where legally permitted.
If Venturo introduces advertising or marketing cookies, appropriate notices & controls should be provided.
Venturo processes personal information for purposes including:
Venturo will not process personal information in a way that is incompatible with the purpose for which it was collected unless there is an appropriate legal basis to do so.
Depending on the circumstances, Venturo may process personal information where:
you have consented to the processing;
processing is necessary to perform an agreement with you;
processing is necessary to comply with a legal obligation;
processing protects a legitimate interest of the User;
processing is necessary to pursue Venturo's legitimate interests or those of a third party, subject to applicable law; or
another lawful basis recognised under POPIA applies.
Venturo will use consent where consent is the appropriate legal basis.
Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent subject to applicable law and any processing that is independently permitted on another lawful basis.
For example, Venturo may use these signals to decide which activities, events or communities appear higher in your personalised discovery experience.
These recommendations are intended to reduce irrelevant results & improve discovery.
Venturo's recommendation features are not intended to make automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects on Users.
Personalisation does not guarantee that every recommendation will be suitable, available or of interest to the User.
Venturo may send marketing communications about activities, events, membership offers, community updates, promotions or other Venturo news where permitted by law.
Where consent is required, Venturo will request it separately.
Marketing consent is optional and is not required simply to create a Venturo account or make a purchase.
Users may withdraw or change their marketing preference using the unsubscribe functionality provided or by contacting Venturo.
Opting out of marketing does not prevent Venturo from sending necessary service communications such as:
other communications necessary to provide the service.
If you allow push notifications, Venturo may send notifications relating to:
Marketing push notifications will be handled in accordance with applicable marketing requirements.
You can manage push-notification permissions through your device settings and, where available, Venturo settings.
Venturo may share personal information with third parties where reasonably necessary to operate the Platform or comply with law.
To process payments, verify subscriptions, manage refunds or confirm membership status.
To host Venturo systems, databases, files & media.
To manage accounts, login functionality, security & fraud prevention.
To understand performance, diagnose errors & improve the Platform.
To support maps, location search, distance information & related functionality.
To deliver email, notifications or other service communications.
Such as accountants, auditors, attorneys or other professional advisers where reasonably necessary.
Where disclosure is required or permitted by law.
Where information needs to be shared to fulfil a transaction, benefit or request and where the User has been appropriately informed.
Venturo does not sell personal information to advertisers.
Third parties that process personal information on Venturo's behalf may act as operators for purposes of POPIA.
Venturo expects operators handling personal information on its behalf to process that information appropriately, maintain reasonable safeguards & use the information only for authorised purposes.
Key technologies used by Venturo may include third-party payment, subscription, mapping, authentication, database, hosting, storage, analytics & communication services.
These providers may maintain their own privacy notices describing how they process information in their respective roles.
Some of Venturo's technology or service providers may store or process information outside South Africa.
Where personal information is transferred outside South Africa, Venturo will take reasonable steps to ensure that the transfer complies with applicable requirements under POPIA.
This may include relying on appropriate contractual protections, applicable legal protections, consent where appropriate or another lawful basis for the transfer.
Venturo takes reasonable technical & organisational measures to protect personal information against:
These measures may include appropriate authentication, access controls, security monitoring, encryption, restricted administrative access, backups & security procedures.
No online system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Venturo therefore reviews security risks & safeguards as its systems develop.
Users also play an important role in account security and should protect their login credentials & notify Venturo if they suspect unauthorised account access.
If Venturo becomes aware of a security compromise involving personal information, Venturo will investigate the incident and take appropriate steps to contain & remediate it.
Where notification is required under applicable law, Venturo will notify the Information Regulator and affected data subjects as required.
steps Users may take to protect themselves; and
Venturo keeps personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected or as required or permitted by law.
whether the User has an active account;
whether information is required to provide a service;
When information is no longer required, Venturo will delete, destroy, de-identify or otherwise handle it in accordance with applicable law & operational requirements.
Users may request deletion of their Venturo account using the available in-app functionality or by contacting Venturo.
Deleting an account may remove or disable access to information including:
Account deletion does not necessarily require immediate deletion of every record.
Venturo may retain information where required or permitted for purposes such as:
Information retained after account deletion will no longer be used for ordinary personalisation or marketing where such use is no longer appropriate.
Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:
ask whether Venturo holds personal information about you;
request access to your personal information;
request deletion or destruction of information where appropriate;
withdraw consent where processing relies on consent;
request information about how your information is processed; and
lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator.
Venturo may need to verify your identity before acting on certain privacy requests.
This protects personal information from being disclosed or altered at the request of an unauthorised person.
Certain information may be updated directly through your Venturo profile or account settings.
If information cannot be changed directly, you may contact Venturo to request correction.
Venturo may retain a record of previous information where required for legal, transaction, fraud-prevention or audit purposes.
Venturo is primarily designed for adults discovering activities, events & communities for themselves, their families or others.
Adults may use Venturo to discover activities suitable for children.
Venturo does not intentionally seek to create behavioural or marketing profiles directly from children where this would not be lawful.

Where Venturo introduces functionality specifically involving the personal information of children, appropriate parental or guardian involvement and additional safeguards will be implemented where required by law.
If you believe a child has provided personal information to Venturo inappropriately, please contact us.
Venturo-operated events may sometimes involve photography or video.
Where event photography is planned, Venturo may notify attendees through event information, signage, event communications or another appropriate method.

Where identifiable photographs or video are intended for marketing purposes, Venturo will consider the nature of the event, the context in which the media was captured & any consent or other lawful basis required.
Attendees who have concerns about photography should contact Venturo or the event representative.
Venturo will take reasonable steps to respect legitimate privacy concerns.
Certain information Users choose to publish may be visible to other Users.
other information deliberately shared through public or community-facing features.
Users should consider this before publishing information.
Where possible, privacy settings or visibility controls may be provided for relevant features.
Venturo may provide links to third-party websites, booking platforms, businesses, maps or social-media services.
When you leave the Venturo Platform and interact with another organisation, that organisation's privacy practices may apply.
Venturo does not control the privacy practices of independent third parties.
Users should review the relevant privacy information before providing personal information directly to another organisation.
Venturo may collect factual information about businesses, activities & events from:
Venturo uses this information for directory, discovery, verification & business-contact purposes.
Where the information identifies an individual rather than only a business, Venturo will process it in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.
Venturo may update this Privacy Policy as its Platform, business, technology or legal obligations develop.
The latest version will be made available through the Venturo website and, where appropriate, the mobile application.
The date of the latest update will appear at the top of this Policy.
Where a change materially affects how existing personal information is processed, Venturo will provide additional notice where appropriate or required.
Privacy enquiries, requests or objections may be directed to:
Viatori Ventures (Pty) Ltd trading as Venturo
If you have a concern about how Venturo handles your personal information, please contact Venturo first so that we can investigate the matter.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the South African Information Regulator.
The Information Regulator's contact information may change from time to time. Current information can be obtained directly from the Information Regulator.
This Privacy Policy should be read together with:
any additional privacy notice presented for a specific feature or service.
